verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The note proves exact alphabet-independent compilers, sharp cell-sum endpoints, sparse witnesses, and Bell(h) state minimality for the explicitly defined existential-support residual; the framing does not promote that state lower bound into a running-time or universal decision-diagram lower bound. The Bell(h) theorem is confined to unrestricted complete-predecessor mechanisms and does not extend to prescribed sparse graphs, factorized exogeneity, cycles, or succinct nested queries. The only demonstrated computational separation is against a deliberately path-retaining numeric-history baseline, while no implementation or benchmark establishes gains over competitive reduced representations on substantive counterfactual-bound problems. These scope and evidence limitations keep the package below flagship significance and constrain its leading-econometrics-journal score despite the complete same-object theorem package. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.5 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]

HALTED AT TRIAGE: the math panel returned `revise` and its findings were never repaired, so this note is NOT established as mathematically sound — do not bank it as downgraded on this verdict alone. Open findings: closest-comparison-missing@thm:single-conjunction-compiler, related-work-incomplete@thm:joint-score-compiler, ballast@thm:residual-minimality-resolution
